summary: GRANDSTAND Ltd (formerly Gambling.com Group Ltd) filed a Form 6-K containing its unaudited interim financial statements for the six months ended June 30, 2026. The filing is a routine periodic report under the 1934 Act, resembling an SEC Form 10-Q equivalent, with no transactional or special-situations content. It includes standard IFRS financial data, segment information, and risk disclosures, but no acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, restructuring, or management change announcements. Accordingly, this filing does not qualify as a special situation and should be classified as None.
